selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid/gid assignment.

selected_evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config with nofile/nproc limits and confirmed the actual ulimit values (8192, 256) inside a real login shell for appworker.
Captured boot_id, uptime, and confirmed appworker account and limits config present before restart.
Backgrounded shutdown -r now so REBOOT_ACK was returned to the caller before the node dropped.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart / changed boot identity proof
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable immediately after the reboot command, then came back with a new boot_id (8660e8f0... -> 656b844c...), proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of account and limits
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account and limits.d config still present, and su -l login session still enforces ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256.
